title: Contextual GraphRAG for Academic Literature Exploration
summary: An LLM‑augmented retrieval system that combines dense vector search with a Neo4j knowledge graph of research papers, enabling multi‑hop, citation‑aware answers to complex scholarly queries.
tech_stack: FastAPI (lightweight HTTP API)
LangChain (LLM orchestration)
LangGraph (stateful graph‑based agent)
OpenAI gpt‑4o-mini (cheap LLM)
Sentence‑Transformers (embedding model)
Postgres + pgvector (store paper embeddings)
Neo4j (property graph for citations, entities, sections)
Docker (containerization)
GitHub Actions (CI/CD)
OpenTelemetry (observability)

title: Privacy-Preserving Personal Photo Summarizer
summary: A local‑only web service that clusters a user's personal photos, extracts event‑level descriptions, and generates concise natural‑language summaries (with optional audio) while guaranteeing zero data leaves the device.
tech_stack: FastAPI – lightweight async API for image upload and retrieval
React – responsive UI for drag‑drop photo upload and story browsing
CLIP (open‑source ViT‑B/32) – extracts 512‑dim visual embeddings locally
Sentence‑Transformers (all‑MiniLM‑L6‑v2) – optional text embedding for captions
PostgreSQL + pgvector – persists embeddings and enables fast ANN search
Ollama running Llama‑3‑8B – generates event narratives without external API calls
Docker & Docker‑Compose – reproducible dev and production environments
GitHub Actions – CI linting and test automation
OpenTelemetry – end‑to‑end tracing for performance debugging
DVC – versioning of sample photo datasets and model checkpoints
